caption: The drawing is a monochrome line illustration on a light beige background. It depicts a full-length dress with long sleeves and a fitted bodice. The bodice is detailed with prominent, puffed shoulders and a high neckline, and there are visible seam lines that contour the waist. The skirt is long and flowing, flaring outward from the waist with vertical lines indicating pleats or folds. The hem of the skirt is adorned with a band of decorative trim featuring a repeating pattern. The dress is drawn without any figure inside, and the outlines of the garment are defined with thin, even black lines. There are small, scattered brown spots across the paper surface. In the lower right corner, there are faintly embossed or written letters.
title: Dress
